content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that the temporary `SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping` object was being discarded too early before the global optimization process could utilize it. This premature nullification of `savedFilteringAndGrouping` meant that if global optimization was triggered subsequently, it did not have access to the required filtering and grouping data, leading to improper functioning of the asynchronous global optimization introduced in a previous commit. The modification ensures that the data is not discarded until it is evidently no longer needed, allowing for proper utilization during the optimization process.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was that the temporary `SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping` object was being discarded too early before the global optimization process could utilize it. This premature nullification of `savedFilteringAndGrouping` meant that if global optimization was triggered subsequently, it did not have access to the required filtering and grouping data, leading to improper functioning of the asynchronous global optimization introduced in a previous commit. The modification ensures that the data is not discarded until it is evidently no longer needed, allowing for proper utilization during the optimization process.
Patch:
From 78e3042946af79fdf0a60fc6a2fea63af618d83b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?David=20H=C3=B6rl?= <hoerldavid@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Aug 2017 17:47:37 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fix bug where saved SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping was
 discarded before it could be used by the asynchronous global optimization
 (introduced in acef72c39cbf097729924faebb8b92c825642e33)

---
 src/main/java/gui/StitchingExplorerPanel.java            | 9 +++++++--
 .../java/gui/popup/OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch.java | 9 ++++++++-
 2 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/main/java/gui/StitchingExplorerPanel.java b/src/main/java/gui/StitchingExplorerPanel.java
index 80df11b..a0d3eb6 100644
--- a/src/main/java/gui/StitchingExplorerPanel.java
+++ b/src/main/java/gui/StitchingExplorerPanel.java
@@ -228,8 +228,13 @@ public class StitchingExplorerPanel<AS extends AbstractSpimData< ? >, X extends
 				OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch globalOptPopup = (OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch) globalOptPopupOpt.get();
 				globalOptPopup.doClick();
 			}
-			// discard the temp. SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping
-			savedFilteringAndGrouping = null;
+			else
+			{
+				// discard the temp. SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping
+				// if we discard it right now, but want to do global opt (which runs asynchronously)
+				// it would not work. therefore, the global optimization will take care of this
+				savedFilteringAndGrouping = null;
+			}
 		}
 	}
 
diff --git a/src/main/java/gui/popup/OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch.java b/src/main/java/gui/popup/OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch.java
index b7ebfbb..ff479a8 100644
--- a/src/main/java/gui/popup/OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch.java
+++ b/src/main/java/gui/popup/OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch.java
@@ -97,7 +97,8 @@ public class OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch extends JMenuItem
 						return;
 
 					SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping< AbstractSpimData< ? > > filteringAndGrouping;
-					if ( ( (StitchingExplorerPanel< ?, ? >) panel ).getSavedFilteringAndGrouping() == null )
+					final boolean isSavedFaG = ( ( (StitchingExplorerPanel< ?, ? >) panel ).getSavedFilteringAndGrouping() == null );
+					if ( isSavedFaG )
 					{
 						FilteredAndGroupedExplorerPanel< AbstractSpimData< ? >, ? > panelFG = (FilteredAndGroupedExplorerPanel< AbstractSpimData< ? >, ? >) panel;
 						filteringAndGrouping = new SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping< AbstractSpimData< ? > >(
@@ -279,6 +280,12 @@ public class OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch extends JMenuItem
 
 					}
 
+					if (isSavedFaG)
+					{
+						// remove saved filtering and grouping once we are done here
+						( (StitchingExplorerPanel< ?, ? >) panel ).setSavedFilteringAndGrouping( null );
+					}
+
 					panel.bdvPopup().updateBDV();
 
 				}
